title: Avro Lancaster JB286
memorial_type: Roll of honour or book of remembrance
memorial_details: A display of the fate of the aircraft with photographs, biographies, a dedication from a crew member's family and a Roll of Honour commemorating the crew members.
inscription: ROLL OF HONOUR / IN PROUD AND LOVING MEMORY / OF OUR DARLING SON, AND BROTHER (BILL) 426422. F/O. W.A. McNAMEE, AGED 21 / (...) / ALSO A LOVING / MEMORY OF HIS GALLANT CREW WHO ALL PERISHED WITH HIM.
community_connection: The memorial is held by Norwich Aviation Museum.
